title: Translated, specific companion error messages
goal: Every companion error has English and Italian text, and revoked, unreachable and changed-certificate cases are told apart
acceptance: A committed Swift test fails before the fix for an English error text and for a 401 mapped to the pair-again message
A pin mismatch says the certificate changed and nothing was sent
No credential, ticket or token appears in any message
escalation: A change to what is sent or to pinning goes to a fresh-context review

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-12: status-code and pin-failure mapping, English texts, Swift tests. Not a measurement.
